verdict.rationale: TaxJar ingests transactions and generates per-state reports that AutoFile migrates into returns, which implies filing-ready detail by jurisdiction. It also mentions reporting and keeps an archive of historical sales tax data. Nothing shows a real-time accrued-liability view, a collected-versus-owed comparison, or exports aimed at accountants or GL systems. Missing for 10: real-time liability-by-jurisdiction dashboard, collected-vs-owed reconciliation, accountant/GL export formats, independent corroboration.
